    LimelightIO
    Reads one Limelight's MegaTag1 or MegaTag2 estimate into PoseSourceInputs.
    OrinCameraInputs
    Everything one Orin (Jetson + PhotonVision) camera reported since the last loop, as an AdvantageKit input: the raw PhotonLib results plus the Jetson's per-camera topics.
    OrinCameraIO
    Hardware layer for one Orin camera: reads it into OrinCameraInputs, and carries the few commands the robot sends it.
    OrinGyroSourceIO
    An Orin camera pose source that uses the robot's heading instead of solving for it.
    OrinGyroSourceIO.Mode
    Which estimate this source makes.
    OrinPoseSourceIO
    The Orin camera's pose source: reads the camera into logged OrinCameraInputs, then solves poses from those inputs with OrinSolver.
    OrinSolver
    Turns one Orin camera's logged PhotonLib results into pose observations.
    PhotonOrinIO
    One PhotonVision camera on the Jetson Orin, read with PhotonLib alpha-2 (the robot must stay on alpha-2: it is the Jetson's wire format).
    SimVision
    Simulated cameras for every pose source, on PhotonLib's VisionSystemSim.
